newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-June onshore crude output 71.07 mln T.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-June onshore crude output 71.07 mln T.

text.p: China's onshore crude oil production totalled 71.07 million tonnes in the first half of the year, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday quoting the China National Petroleum Corp.
Output of natural gas was 8.41 billion cubic metres in the same period, it said.
Onshore daily output in the first half increased by 4,389 tonnes compared with the same period last year, it quoted a senior China National Petroleum Corp (CNPC) official as saying.
Older oilfields in eastern regions maintained stable output and completed 50.37 percent of the state-set annual output target, he said.

However, production from newly developed fields in western China saw sharp rises, with average daily output exceeding the figure in the same period last year by 6,350 tonnes, he said without giving further details.
By end-May, oilfields at Daqing, Shengli, Liaohe, Henan, Dagang and Xinjiang had begun using polymer-propelling and injecting water into wells to produce more oil, he said.
The new technology had helped to boost crude output by 1.08 million tonnes in the first half and an increase of 2.6 million tonnes was expected for the whole year, he said.
The report gave no further details.
